name: xk-cross-border
description: Prepare Kosovo cross-border corporate business-income working papers for 2026. Screen residence, domestic permanent establishments and treaty entitlement before choosing gross nonresident service withholding or the net-profit route. Classify interest, royalties and rent, reconcile foreign income and capped foreign-tax credits, identify actual asset disposals and liquidation, and prepare monthly WR reporting and annual certificates. Trigger on Kosovo foreign suppliers, nonresident services, branch profits, tax treaties, foreign tax credit, withholding gross-up, permanent establishment and MAP requests. Covers current statutes and TAK's revised treaty-form procedure. The statutory service-PE proviso and specified implementation questions remain expressly unresolved; individual employment and sole-trader calculations use the linked Kosovo skills.
